adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, the calendar update is performed via `getUsersCredentials(ctx.user)` and `new EventManager({ ...user, credentials: [...credentials] })` where `user` is the requester (`ctx.user`), not the booking organizer fetched earlier (`organizer`). This means an attendee/team admin invoking `addGuests` will attempt `eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking)` using their own credentials, which can fail or be unauthorized for the organizer’s calendar event.
